local_behavior: Empty/noeligible list selects slot0; no empty-list/no-match rejection or table-pointer validity test on this path.
reset_behavior: 22C930 clears only installedCount, not pointer-table bytes. Fresh decoder entry subsequently imports ESI0 and MSCAL selects retained slot0 after flush.
sentinel_limit: Under only valid MPG-produced u16 list entries, best0/u16 never reaches10000; sentinel comparison does not reject absence of a candidate. Arbitrary corrupted list contents unqualified.

witnesses.path: Both unsigned JB paths leave initialEAX0

consumer_qualification: Largest eligible address if one exists; otherwise slot0. Count reset removes eligibility list count but does not erase pointer table. Slot0 must be valid if dispatch is allowed.
not_claimed: No actual invalid shipped command, null/stale function invocation, callback/drawing effects, normal reset frequency, universal capacity/lifetime or full family census.
limits: Local original flow, not native helper/callback effects, normal reset scheduling, actual packet occurrence, all-time state/table extent or rendered consequences. Existing imm16/unmasked and room-only type qualification preserved, not rediscovered.
